questions.question: What are the valid indexes of an array with length 6?
questions.explanation: Array indexes begin at zero and stop at length minus one.

questions.question: What does new Account[3] create?
options: One array with three null reference cells
questions.explanation: Each Account must still be constructed and assigned to a cell.

questions.question: Why can a method mutate an array supplied by its caller?
options: The copied parameter reference leads to the same array object
Arrays are passed by reference instead of by value
The method receives every caller variable
questions.explanation: Java remains pass-by-value; the value copied here is a shared object reference.

questions.question: A 50-cell Book array currently stores two books. Which bound should process populated books?
questions.explanation: Logical size and physical capacity are different.
